ABOUT YOU defaults to required; OUR TECH STACK is a required stack list. No heading marks an optional section.
The inline plus makes experience working under EU data-residency constraints optional; that practice has no precise taxonomy entry. Fintech and private-markets experience are domain knowledge and excluded.
Frontend and Backend are explicitly named in the stack and are labeled alongside the specific technologies; no unnamed parent skills are added.
Tool contracts and context engineering are read literally and left unmapped rather than equated with tool calling or prompt engineering.
MCP, guardrails, deployment, architecture, and other technologies or practices appearing only in responsibilities are excluded.
Mastra and ai-sdk are requested in ABOUT YOU and the stack but have no taxonomy entries; ai-sdk and Vercel ai-sdk are treated as the same technology.
Neither German nor a degree is requested.
